sections.text: Continued RIH from 767 mmd to 807 mmd.
M/u pump-in stand. M/u TDS, took up/down weight 94/88 ton. Washed top of EZSV 1000 LPM 5 bar. Stung into EZSV plug at 811 mmd. Sat down 10 ton.

Closed UPR and lined-up for displacing annulus to SW. Pumped 20m3 hi-vis pill followed by SW. MAX gas peak 5 MAX h2s peak 4ppm in gas trap, no h2s measured in air. Stopped pumping when clean SW in returns and gas readings decreased below 2 totally pumped 140m3 SW. Meanwhile performed TBT for cement job. Tested dump line.
Opened BOP. Lined up to TT and flowchecked well for 10 min, static.
Installed cement hose. Meanwhile prepared to pump wash pill.

Pumped 20 m3 of wash pill, 1200 l/min/ 13 bar. Mixed and pumped 35 m3 of 1,95 SG cement slurry, 580 LPM 15 bar. Full returns. Displaced cement down drill string with 11 m3 FW at 1200 LPM. Pressure increased from 17 bar to 61 bar during displacement.
Stung out of EZSV plug and picked up 2,5 m above the plug. Mixed and pumped 7,7 m3 1,95 SG cement slurry, 600 LPM 15 bar. Displaced cement with 7 m3 FW, using cement pump, 1000 LPM 15 bar.
Removed cement hose and l/o cement stand.

POOH 2 stands to 700 mmd. Installed sponge ball. Circulated 1 x b/u, 3500 LPM/ 32 bar at 50 RPM. MAX gas 9 5 ppm h2s in gas trap at b/u. No h2s measured in air. Dumped returns when clean SW at shakers.
Disconnected TDS. POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 700 mmd to 80 mmd. Avg. Tripping speed 620 m/hr.
Removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing
POOH from 80 mmd to surface, using manual slips.
Removed springs from EZSV RT, b/o and l/d same. P/u cement stand. B/o and l/d 2 pup joints and pump-in sub.
WOC meanwhile p/u wellbore fishing assembly. B/o and l/o XO and jetting sub.
WOC meanwhile function tested shear ram. RIH with jetting sub, spaced out and function tested all BOP rams. M/u to TDS and jetted BOP 3 x passes. POOH with jet sub.

WOC meanwhile isolated drilling equipment and performed maintenance. Pressure tested aft PRS hyd hoses. Performed PMS and inspections on FWD PRS performed PMS on TDS traveling equipment prepared equipment for changing out PRS wires.

WOC meanwhile continued performing rig maintenance. Performed PMS and inspections on FWD PRS. Performed PMS on foxhole. Megger tested TDS from switch board room. Removed pop off on stand pipe manifold and pressure tested stand pipe drag chain hoses to 520 bar. Prepared for n/d diverter and BOP
